question: When does the city library open on Sundays?
title: Library hours
body: The city library opens at 10 a.m. from Monday to Saturday. On Sundays the doors open at noon and close at 5 p.m.

question: How much does a monthly bus pass cost?
title: Bus passes
body: Riders can buy single tickets on the bus. Weekly passes are sold at the central station. Prices change every January.

question: Which trail is closed for repairs?
title: Park notice
body: The river trail is closed until the bridge is repaired. The hill trail and the lake trail remain open, although the lake trail may be muddy.

question: What should residents do with old batteries?
title: Recycling guide
body: Paper and glass go in the blue bin. Old batteries must not go in any bin; take them to a collection point. Ask staff where the nearest one is.

question: How long is the swimming pool closed?
title: Pool update
body: The swimming pool will close for cleaning next week. It reopens on Monday after the work is finished.
